subject.title: fix(reef): bound legacy state file reads in doctor migration

question: Should Reef doctor preserve and provide a recovery path for valid legacy state that exceeds the proposed migration cap, or is refusing migration with an operator remediation workflow the intended durable-data contract?
rationale: The code can mechanically enforce a chosen policy, but only a Reef owner can decide whether potentially complete legacy audit/replay state may be omitted from migration and what recovery guarantee users receive.

options.title: Preserve and migrate bounded data
options.body: Implement a bounded import or archival strategy that retains valid legacy state while preventing unbounded allocation.

options.title: Fail with guided remediation
options.body: Keep refusal semantics only with explicit documentation and a doctor-visible recovery process for safely handling the legacy files.

recommendation.title: Preserve and migrate bounded data
recommendation.body: Implement a bounded import or archival strategy that retains valid legacy state while preventing unbounded allocation.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed implementation and can route the durable-state contract question to the appropriate Reef history owner.
